title: Intention-to-Treat Error
coreMove: Use Intention-to-Treat Error as the warning label, then make the specific correction before the choice moves forward.
sourcePressure: The frozen TOC and official source notes frame Intention-to-Treat Error as a specific decision error around intention-to-treat, assigned groups, clinical trials. Traceable support includes Statistical Considerations in the Intent-to-Treat Principle.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Intention-to-Treat Error as generic advice to be smarter, instead of forcing this exact move: use intention-to-treat error as the warning label, then make the specific correction before the choice moves forward.
